Indonesia Candy Factory Fire: Dozens Missing, Bodies Recovered

A fire at a candy factory in Indonesia has resulted in a significant number of missing persons and recovered bodies. As of the latest reports, 24 body bags have been sent for identification, with 34 individuals still unaccounted for. The death toll has risen to at least 24. The incident occurred at a candy factory, and recovery efforts are ongoing, with more remains being found.
